npcs.name: Elder Maren
lines: The gate's open. The old road goes up to his forge, and nowhere else now: the deep ways are shut, and good riddance.
Pixelheim stands again. Fifty years I kept a village and a secret, and only one of them was worth keeping.
ashesLines: Fafnyr came down off the mountain and the village burned in one night. We are what's left.
Odo, Hilda and Vex trade from the square until they have roofs again. Sela keeps a tent for anyone who needs a bed.
The mayor's ledger survived. Rebuild us, and then - then we go up that mountain.

lines: You came up the road as the fire came down the mountain. Who are you?
(You hand her the letter.) Vellmar's seal. I wrote to them three times.
(She reads it twice.) Then no one is coming. Again. Fifty years ago I asked the Crown for soldiers too.
(She looks up at the mountain for a long time.) Rest. We'll talk at dawn.

gateLines: Pixelheim stands again, and the mountain doesn't care. Its gate stays barred until what the five left behind comes home.
Saltmere, Blackiron, Greyhold, the Frostgate. The five scattered their keepsakes across the Reach before they climbed.
Rebuild us, bring the relics home, and then we talk about the mountain. In that order, courier.

npcs.name: Ana
lines: The merchant waters down his elixirs, I swear it. Buy the cheese instead.
Stay on the roads if you value your ankles. The packs in the fields don't wait for introductions.

npcs.name: Bram
lines: I saw a wolf take a whole cheese wheel off a traveler once. Rolled it away and everything.
Me? Climb the mountain? I have a perfectly good fence to lean on right here.
(A man lies pinned under a burning beam. You put your shoulder to it. It shifts - then rolls away.)
The beam - you got it off - thank you. Thank you. I'm Bram. I'll live, I think. Probably.
Sela's set up a tent on the square for the hurt. Go. I'll follow when my legs remember how.

npcs.name: Merchant Odo
lines: Welcome, welcome! Finest goods this side of the mountain. The counter is always open.

npcs.name: Smith Hilda
lines: The forge takes gold, not promises. Bring me a blade and coin and I will make both sharper.
Seven folds is the most any steel will take. After that it is the arm, not the iron.

npcs.name: Alchemist Vex
lines: Herbs, reeds, shards - I pay full price for reagents. The wilds are a garden if you survive them.
The elixir recipe? One of each, child. Nature likes a balanced potion.

npcs.name: Innkeeper Sela
lines: Ten gold for a bed and no questions. The bards say my stew brought a man back from the brink.
It was the stew or the poultice. Probably the stew.
Sit. You're bleeding and you haven't even noticed. ... There.
I'm Sela. I kept the inn, when there was an inn. Now I keep a tent and more hurt than I have cloth for.
Maren's at the shrine. She's the elder - she'll want to know who you are, walking in out of the fire.

npcs.name: Mayor Aldric
lines: Pixelheim runs on two things: stubbornness and gold. The first we have. Bring the second to my ledger.
Every coin you invest, the town wears. Come back and see.
ashesLines: The hall stood. Stone does that. Everything else is cinders and stubbornness.
The board on the square lists what we need to rebuild. Coin and a little from the wilds - we'll do the rest.

npcs.name: Mira the Weaver
lines: I came for the market stalls. Stayed for the lamplight. This place is going somewhere.
A village that pays its own way - the mayor talks about you, you know.

3: The fountain brought buyers from the valley. My looms can't keep up.
A village that pays its own way became a town that pays its weavers.
4: Banners on every street. Guess who wove them.
The mayor talks about you. Everyone does now.

npcs.name: Old Tomas
lines: A fountain! I hauled water forty years and now it leaps out of the ground on its own.
New roofs going up everywhere. My grandson has a TRADE now. A trade!

4: Lamps to the mountain gate! I walked it last night just to see. Twice.
My grandson has a trade AND a house. A house!

npcs.name: Serra
lines: A city under the Ashen Mountain. My mother would not believe the streetlights.
They say the one who paid for all this walks around in plain armor. Imagine that.

npcs.name: Fenn
lines: Paved streets! My cart has never rolled so smooth.
I sell to the merchants here now. City prices, friend. City prices.

npcs.name: The cat
lines: The cat looks at you, then at your boots, then away. You have been judged.

npcs.name: The dog
lines: The dog leans its whole weight on your leg and sighs, very content.

npcs.name: Pip
lines: Are you the one who fights the monsters? I fight monsters too. Mostly the goose.

npcs.name: Nell
lines: Tag! You're it! ...You're not going to chase me, are you. Grown-ups never chase.

npcs.name: Harbourmaster Brin
lines: Saltmere's small, but she's honest. Mostly. The crabs aren't, and neither are the smugglers.
The lighthouse on the point went dark years ago. A town that can't see the sea shouldn't live by it.

npcs.name: Ola the Fisher
lines: Fishing? Stand at the end of the jetty, face the water, press E. The fish come back every little while.
The lagoon's good, and the rocks out east. Every so often the sea gives you a pearl. Or a boot.

npcs.name: Rook
lines: Don't look at me like that. I'm the honest kind of smuggler. I only rob other smugglers.
Their captain sits on the north-east beach counting what isn't his. Someone ought to send him on his way.

npcs.name: Foreman Garrick
lines: Blackiron's the best iron in the Reach and the worst place to dig it. Goblins in the upper shafts, something worse below.
Fifty years back five strangers came up this road for a cartload of black iron. Said it was for a seal. Paid in gold, too.

npcs.name: Dagny
lines: Hilda in Pixelheim would kill for this ore. Bring her some and see her smile. Once a year, she smiles.
The stone golems have taken to the cart hall. Rails don't run themselves.

npcs.name: Fenwick
lines: I wore the red cloak, once. Then they threw me in the cells for asking where the pay went.
Ulla let me stay. I fetch the water. It's a living.

npcs.name: Gunnar
lines: Three wagons up, one wagon down, and the down one's stuck. That's the Frostgate for you.
The yetis took the strongbox and left the furs. Even they know what's worth stealing.

npcs.name: Linnea
lines: I'm the caravan's herbalist. Up here that mostly means rubbing snow on frostbite.
Frost lilies only open in the snow. Vex in Pixelheim swears by them.

npcs.name: Marta the Chandler
lines: Rope, tar and lamp oil. And fish. Mostly fish.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Brann
lines: The mine pays in iron, I sell in iron.

npcs.name: Mabel the Sutler
lines: I sell what keeps soldiers alive.

npcs.about: PIX-253 step 8: the last of the five who climbed, who never came down. Fifty years at the forge at the top of the mountain road mending the seal on Fafnyr's collar with Blackiron iron, counting the village's lamps on his wall; the fifth letter is to him (letter_morvax: its answer, `quake` and `after`). Step 10 brings him home, or not (Homecoming: by the fountain after the collar, on his bench there once home, `alsoOn`), saying what progression.json's `home` has him say.
npcs.name: Morvax
lines: You're late, courier. Fifty years late.
(He doesn't look up from the cold anvil.) If Maren wants something, Maren can climb. ...She won't. Neither will I.

recruits.name: Iva the Healer
meetLines: Careful in the fen. I patch up what it bites, but I am running out of reeds to bind with.
A town with a shrine and no healer... bring me three marsh reeds and I will set up beside it.
recruits.askLine: Three marsh reeds, and my tent moves to Pixelheim.
recruits.joinedLine: Reeds enough to start with. Find me by the shrine - and come to me before you climb.
townLines: Sit. Breathe. There - whole again. My door is always open to the town's patron.
The shrine hums some nights. Good company for a healer.
recruits.perk: Iva heals you whole, free, whenever you're in town

2: The lamps help. People come to me before dark now, not after.
3: A fountain by the square and clean water at last. Half my work was the water.
4: A city needs a hospice. I've asked the mayor. He said 'after the flower beds'.

recruits.perkUp: Iva heals you whole, free, whenever you're in town, and tops your healing potions up to three

recruits.name: Loras the Bard
meetLines: A bard in a forest sings to trees. Trees, friend, do not tip.
A troll in this wood took my lute to pick its teeth with. Get it back and I will make your battles sound like legends, by Pixelheim's lamplight.
recruits.askLine: My lute back from the troll, and I follow you home.
recruits.tierLine: Sing for a hamlet? Darling, no. Light some lamps first - make Pixelheim a village, then we talk.
recruits.joinedLine: A patron! Pixelheim gains its first verse tonight.
townLines: A song before you march! There - carry that fire into the fight, it sharpens the blade's edge.
I am composing 'The Ballad of the Ashen Patron'. It needs a triumphant ending. No pressure.
recruits.perk: Loras plays a marching song before a hunt: +12% crit until it ends

3: 'The Ballad of the Ashen Patron', verse nine: the fountain. It rhymes with mountain, which is a gift.
A song before you march! Carry that fire into the fight.
4: A city deserves an anthem. I have the tune. I need the ending - Morvax's, ideally.
A song before you march! Carry that fire into the fight.

recruits.perkUp: Loras plays a marching song with a war-horn before a hunt: +20% crit until it ends

recruits.name: Wren the Stablemaster
meetLines: Lost my stable to the fire. Been walking travelers' horses by the gate ever since.
Two wolf pelts for saddle leather and I will run a proper post in town - straight to the square, no gate queue.
recruits.askLine: Two wolf pelts for the saddles, and the stable is Pixelheim's.
recruits.joinedLine: Leather enough! The post stands by the north road - the square is a whistle away now.
townLines: The post runs like a dream. Fast travel drops you right at the square now - no gate queue.
Horses hate the ash fields. Smart animals.
recruits.perk: Wren's post: travel to the town gate lands you on the square

3: The fountain spooks the young horses. They'll learn. So did I.
Fast travel to the gate drops you on the square - my post runs like a dream.
4: Lamps all the way to the mountain gate. I ride the night shift for fun now.
Fast travel to the gate drops you on the square - my post runs like a dream.

recruits.perkUp: Wren's post: travel to the town gate lands you on the square, and you walk a tenth faster above ground

recruits.name: Mirelle the Banker
meetLines: I count coins for caravans that never stop anywhere worth banking in.
Put two gems in a vault worth guarding, and I will make Pixelheim's money WORK.
recruits.askLine: Two gems for the vault, and the bank follows you home.
recruits.tierLine: A bank needs streets and lamps, not a hamlet of tents. Grow Pixelheim into a village and we will talk.
recruits.joinedLine: Capital received. Find my ledger by the city hall - bring your idle gold.
townLines: Idle gold is lazy gold. Savings, a caravan, an expansion - put it to work.
The mayor builds with your gold. I make it come BACK. We are not the same.
recruits.perk: Mirelle's bank: savings that grow, caravans and expansions

4: City prices, city deposits. Pixelheim's gold finally comes back to Pixelheim.
Idle gold is lazy gold. Savings, a caravan, an expansion - put it to work.

recruits.perkUp: Mirelle's bank: savings that grow 3% a day, caravans and expansions

recruits.about: PIX-255 (story chapter 2): Tam's sister doesn't ask to be helped; the story brings her home. Once her letter is delivered (`comesHome.letter`) and Tam's Ladle is won (`comesHome.named`), she moves into Sela's inn (`home`, beside Sela's tent while the inn is ash: `homeRuined`) and puts Tam's stew back on the menu: a night at the inn leaves the hero rested `inn.fights` fights longer. The town's tour stops at the inn's door for her homecoming (`homecoming`).
recruits.name: Old Wenna

comesHome.line: Old Wenna is packing for Pixelheim: Sela's inn has a room going, and somebody has to make Tam's stew properly.

meetLines: My brother Tam went up that mountain fifty years ago with a ladle in his belt and a joke for everyone. He never came back.
The smugglers pick over every wreck on this beach. If anyone knows what the sea gave back of him, it's them.
townLines: Tam's stew, the way he made it: too much pepper and a song. Sit down before Sela sells the lot.
Maren comes in most nights for a bowl. We don't talk about the mountain. We talk about everything else.
recruits.perk: Tam's stew at Sela's inn: a night there leaves you rested for longer

inn.line: Well rested, too, after a bowl of Tam's stew: more XP for your next %d fights.

homecoming.line: Old Wenna has come to live at Sela's inn. Maren, in the doorway: "Wenna."
homecoming.detail: "You owe me fifty years of letters. Start with a bowl of stew."

recruits.about: PIX-255 (story chapter 3): the boy with the canary who took the five down the shafts, old now. Once his letter is delivered (`comesHome.letter`) and the last ingot is up from the Black Seam (`comesHome.named`), he and his canary move in above Hilda's forge (`home`, by her stall on the square while the forge is ash: `homeRuined`), and he works her bellows: her +1s cost a tenth less again (`perkValues.forge`). The town's tour stops at the forge's door for his homecoming (`homecoming`).
recruits.name: Old Pell

comesHome.line: Old Pell is packing for Pixelheim, canary and all: a forge with a room over it, and nobody digging under his bed.

meetLines: My canary's down there. She tells us when the air goes bad. Without her we're digging blind.
Last I heard her singing, it was off the west gallery. Small cage. Very cross bird.
townLines: Hilda lets me work her bellows. The canary supervises. Loudly.
The cat sits on the anvil to watch the canary. The canary sits on Hilda's head to watch the cat. Hilda has opinions.
recruits.perk: Pell works Hilda's bellows: her +1s cost a tenth less again

homecoming.line: Old Pell and his canary have moved in above Hilda's forge.
homecoming.detail: The canary and the cat have reached an understanding. The understanding is shouting.

recruits.about: PIX-255 (story chapter 4): Captain Hale's sergeant, who took Maren's letter for him. Once it's delivered (`comesHome.letter`) and the Hollow Captain has stood down (`comesHome.named`), she brings the old guard to keep Pixelheim's gate (`home`: just inside it, beside its east torch, off the tower PIX-248 raised where she stood), and her wardens dig out the Frostgate road (the avalanche, gates.json, opens on the same step). The town's tour stops at the gate (`homecoming`).
recruits.name: Sergeant Ulla

comesHome.line: Sergeant Ulla is marching the old guard to Pixelheim: a village with a gate wants someone on it. Her wardens are off to dig out the Frostgate road.

meetLines: Greyhold was Oskar's fort before it was anyone's ruin. We keep this camp because somebody has to.
Turncoats hold the yard now - the ones who sold the garrison's stores and stayed for the walls.
townLines: Pixelheim's gate is kept now. The old guard walks your walls, and my wardens are up the Frostgate road with shovels.
Fifty years he waited for somebody to give the order. You gave it, and he took it. ...Mind how you go, courier.
recruits.perk: Ulla's old guard keeps Pixelheim's gate, and her wardens have dug out the Frostgate road

homecoming.line: Sergeant Ulla and the old guard have taken Pixelheim's gate.
homecoming.detail: "Wardens! Shovels. The Frostgate road won't dig itself."

recruits.about: PIX-255 (story chapter 4): Greyhold's chaplain, who wanted the garrison stood down. Once Maren's letter to Captain Hale is delivered and the Hollow Captain has stood down, he brings Greyhold's mended bell to Pixelheim and hangs it in the town hall (`home`); the town's tour stops at the hall (`homecoming`).
recruits.name: Brother Teo

comesHome.line: Brother Teo is bringing Greyhold's bell down to Pixelheim, to hang in the town hall.

meetLines: The dead below don't rest. They were good men. Nobody ever gave them the order to stand down.
If you go down, mind the crypt. And say a word for them, if you know one.
townLines: Greyhold's bell hangs in your hall now. The mayor jumps every time I ring it. That's half the fun.
When the bell rings, everyone comes. That's what a bell is for. Remember that, if the mountain ever wakes.
recruits.perk: Greyhold's mended bell in the town hall: Pixelheim has a bell to ring again

homecoming.line: Brother Teo has hung Greyhold's mended bell in the town hall.
homecoming.detail: "It rings a little flat. So did the garrison. They'd have liked it here."

recruits.about: PIX-255 (story chapter 5): Liane paid him to keep her lamp oil dry and her door shut, and he has, for fifty years, standing by the observatory's door at the head of the Frostgate pass. Once Maren's letter is delivered (`comesHome.letter`) and Liane's lantern is up from the glass hall (`comesHome.named`), he comes down to be Pixelheim's lamplighter (`home`, by the square), and keeps the courier's lantern trimmed: it lights the dark a third further (`perkValues.lantern`, LightRig). The town's tour stops on the square for his homecoming (`homecoming`).
recruits.name: Aske the Hermit

comesHome.line: Aske is packing for Pixelheim: fifty years is long enough to keep one door, and he hears your village is short of a lamplighter.

meetLines: Liane paid me to keep her lamp oil dry and her door shut. Fifty years on, I'm still doing it. Nobody told me to stop.
She built the observatory over the old ice cave. Said the cold kept her glass true.
townLines: One lamp, fifty years. Forty lamps can't be harder.
Dusk, I light them. Dawn, I put them out. In between, Maren and I sit on the square and talk about Liane. Fifty years nobody said her name to me.
recruits.perk: Aske keeps your lantern trimmed: it lights the dark a third further

homecoming.line: Aske has come down from the Frostgate to light Pixelheim's lamps.
homecoming.detail: "One lamp, fifty years. Forty lamps can't be harder."

cleared: You came back from {floor}? Everyone said nobody comes back from there.
{floor}, was it? My uncle went down there once. Once.
boss: The whole town heard about {boss}. Bram's telling it like he was there.
Is it true about {boss}? You look... normal. I expected taller.
project: Have you seen the {project}? Of course you have - you paid for it.
The {project}! I walked past it three times this morning.
settler: {settler} moved in! Pixelheim is filling up again.
Did you hear? {settler} is one of us now.
hunt: They say you killed {beast}. I'll believe it when I see the head. ...Oh. That's the head.
{beast}, gone! My mother won't believe it. I barely believe it.

festivalBarker.name: Barker Jory
lines: Roll up, roll up! Three rings, three pegs - land two and the prize is yours!
Free to play on a festival day. The mayor's paying, so throw as often as you like.
